project.name: Double Link Pendulum on Cart Hybrid Control
project.description: Clean release for nonlinear simulation and hybrid control of a double link pendulum on a cart. Final public backend for nonlinear simulation, hybrid control, external force recovery evaluation and Python GUI replay.

state_definition.angle_convention: theta = 0 rad means the link points downward. theta = pi rad means the link points upright. Positive angle is counterclockwise from the downward vertical direction.
state_definition.theta2_definition: theta2 is treated as an absolute link angle from the downward vertical direction. This convention must be kept the same in MATLAB and Python.

down_down.description: link 1 downward, link 2 downward; passive equilibrium and controlled local target

external_force.force_model: External forces act on link contact points and are converted into generalized forces with Q_ext = J_contact(q)^T * F_ext_xy.
external_force.direction_convention: 0 rad points right, pi rad points left, pi/2 rad points upward. Force recovery tests use horizontal left/right events.
external_force.force_note: External-force modeling supports the recovery backend.

realism.description: Realism flags used by MATLAB/Simulink pipeline. Keep default values off unless a phase test enables them explicitly.

rail_limit.description: Soft cart rail limit for MATLAB realism mode. Repulsive force starts within x_soft of the rail limit and is saturated by max_wall_force_N.

actuator.description: First-order actuator model. In realism mode, controller output is F_cmd and plant receives delayed/saturated F_actual.

friction.description: Optional extra friction. Existing physical damping remains in physical_parameters; these terms are only used when realism.friction_enabled is true.

sensor_noise.description: Measurement noise for MATLAB realism mode. Noise is added to measurement, not to the true plant state.

estimator.description: Simple state estimator. Positions come from measurement; velocities are estimated from filtered finite differences.

energy_swingup.description: Strict local handoff: energy feedback with optional reference excitation assist. Full Down Down remains diagnostic; safe LQR handoff uses a narrow capture region.
